verdict.rationale: Pandoc is a document-conversion tool and library, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair thing to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence mentions MCP. The documented pandoc-server HTTP mode is an adjacent feature, not an MCP server, and the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
